name: garam-fps
description: GARAM: ZERO HOUR - Competitive 5v5 Tactical FPS

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @garam/shared && npm --workspace=@garam/server run dev
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @garam/shared && concurrently "npm --workspace=@garam/server run dev" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @garam/shared && npm run build -w @garam/server && npm run build -w @garam/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @garam/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
